explainBack.prompt: Why could cancelling Pro $200 today lock you out of the tier tomorrow, even though OpenAI says existing subscribers are unaffected?
explainBack.response: Because the pause blocks entry, not continuation. While your subscription is active it renews as usual — that is the 'unaffected' part. But once a cancellation, completed downgrade, or failed renewal actually ends the plan, you no longer hold an active subscription; buying Pro $200 again would count as a new sign-up, and new sign-ups are exactly what OpenAI paused. So the same account is protected one day and blocked the next, depending on whether the change has taken effect.
